comment: Recorded by NativeThermalConvergenceLedgerVectorsTests; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_THERMAL_CONVERGENCE_LEDGER_VECTORS set to this directory. A revision row runs RefreshIntent(Empty) for its intent, policy and disclosure at Battery and records the three revisions and the normalized effective intent. A document row takes the compact text of its document (or of its base row's), applies each patch [path, value] or removal [path] ('-' appends) and its text replacement, or uses its text, and records the text and the ThermalConvergenceStateStore load for SID S-1-5-21-1-2-3-1001. A transition row starts from Empty and applies refresh (the row's epoch replaces a new device epoch), reserve (candidate revisions from the state, desired = its effective intent) and complete, recording each state and whether TrySaveAsync persists it. A native row is a document the Rust encoder wrote; managed records its load.
